notes.text: CCNL 2022-2025 signed 24/11/2022 (valid 01/04/2022-31/03/2025). CCNL 2025-2028 signed 15/07/2025 (valid 01/04/2025-31/03/2028). Signatories: Confindustria Marmomacchine+ANEPLA+FENEAL-UIL+FILCA-CISL+FILLEA-CGIL.
SPLIT model: paga base + contingenza frozen Nov 1991 + EDR 10.33 EUR. Paga base changes at each tranche; contingenza and EDR modelled as fixed_allowances.
2022-2025 paga base tranches: 31/12/2022 (base), 01/01/2023 (+40 EUR at C), 01/01/2024 (+39 EUR at C), 01/01/2025 (+44 EUR at C). Confirmed from consulenza.it per-level tables.

2025-2028 totals confirmed from cdltorino.it: 01/07/2025, 01/07/2026, 01/07/2027 (+80 EUR per tranche at C reference). Paga base derived by subtracting frozen contingenza and EDR from confirmed totals.
LEVEL F superminimum: +7.75 EUR/month collective superminimum treated as paga base for contractual purposes. Added to paga base values in this file.

DIVISORS: hourly 174 (art. 10 c. 1, p. 21). The 1/25 is the quota of a holiday on a Sunday or the compensatory rest day (art. 18, p. 26), in work_rules.sunday_holidays; the CCNL states no general daily divisor for the absences, which keep the unverified by_26.

limitation.remediation: Find the daily quota of an unpaid absence of the CCNL (or of the payroll practice of the sector) and set work_rules.absence_rules.daily_divisor_method.

notes.text: SENIORITY: 5 biennali (24-month) scatti. Per-level EUR amounts: F=6.65, E=7.69, D=8.31, C=8.82, CS=9.45, B=9.80, A=11.97, AS=13.01. Confirmed from ilccnl.it.

PRE-31/12/2022 HISTORY: the 2022-2025 CCNL is retroactively valid from 01/04/2022. Values for April 2022 through November 2022 are not modelled (data not retrieved from public sources). Engine history starts at 31/12/2022.

APPRENTICESHIP: 2022 CCNL Art. 3d changed system from sotto-inquadramento to percentage ('calcolate in percentuale...come da allegata tabella'). Pre-2022 system confirmed from full CCNL 2008 text (integrating Accordo 15/03/2006): 2 levels below destination for first half of apprenticeship, 1 level below for second half, no seniority increments accrued. Post-2022 percentage values from scanned allegata tabella not extractable (OCR-confirmed: image-only PDF). 2025-2028 rinnovo (12-page OCR) does not modify apprenticeship. Modelled as 1.00 passthrough pending actual 2022+ percentage values.

limitation.remediation: Extract the post-2022 percentage table and model the percentage track.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Apprendistato professionalizzante (accordo 15 marzo 2006), inquadramento e retribuzione, p. 61): no increment during the apprenticeship: 'La retribuzione sarà corrispondente a quella prevista dal vigente c.c.n.l., esclusi gli scatti di anzianità, per il livello iniziale di inquadramento per metà del periodo di apprendistato.' seniority_increments.apprentice_amount 0. The 2025 renewal (OCR) does not mention apprenticeship or increments; the 2022 renewal was not read in full.

CIGO: the operai of the stone-working firms owe 3.30% ('operai delle imprese dell'industria e artigianato lapidei', D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 13 c. 1 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-14, https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.legislativo:2015-09-14;148~art13!vig=2026-10-14, snapshot sha256 3f7019a244e01d36ac8e7c9e25bcf058c777c8ed758418ba261d83867672c46a), lett. d); the industria table charges the 1.70% / 2.00% of lett. a-b, so the employer contributions of an operaio are understated by 1.60 or 1.30 points. Impiegati and quadri owe the 1.70% / 2.00% of lett. e-f the table already charges.

limitation.remediation: Model the CIGO of D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 13 c. 1 by activity (edile, lapidei) apart from the tax sector, then remove this note.

provenance.transformation: The holidays of art. 18 b) (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) and c) (1 and 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 1 November, 8, 25 and 26 December) falling on a Sunday or on the worker's compensatory rest day (Employment.weekly_rest_day): one day of the monthly pay of the chain over 25. The S. Patrono of d) is not in the national calendar and is not paid; 4 October, a holiday from 2026 (L. 151/2025), is not in the list.
provenance.note: Text layer of the 2008 complete text; the renewals of 2010, 2013, 2016, 2019, 2022 and 2025-2028 do not change art. 18 (research of 2026-11-05).

reviews.scope: The seniority increments of the apprentices, Apprendistato professionalizzante (accordo 15 marzo 2006), inquadramento e retribuzione (PDF p. 61), found by a separate research session and checked again on the page.
findings: No increment during the apprenticeship: seniority_increments.apprentice_amount 0.

reviews.scope: Art. 18 (PDF p. 26) and art. 10 (PDF p. 21) of the 2008 complete text, text layer.
findings: Art. 18: a holiday of b), c) or d) on a Sunday or the compensatory rest day pays 1/25 of the monthly pay on top: work_rules.sunday_holidays with divisor 25 and on_rest_day.
Art. 10: the hourly divisor is 174; no general daily divisor of the absences.
